title: Require Map Mod Realization Proof Topology
forbids: map-mod realization tests outside the artifact, deployment, runtime-compatibility, and live-observation confidence axes
why: A map-mod realization must independently prove deterministic output identity, deployment interpretation, generated-module compatibility, and real Civ7 loader behavior. Closed disjoint layers prevent architecture wiring checks or live scripts from collecting in generic test and scripts cabinets.
remediate: Classify each proof by the independent fact it establishes: artifact plan, deployment behavior, runtime compatibility, or uncached live observation. Move product-definition behavior back to its product owner and delete duplicate provider or wiring tests.
message: Map-mod realization proofs must preserve their closed layered topology.
